name: quickdeck
description: Write in several plain-text panes side by side, and bring back earlier text from automatic snapshots.
author: Yoshinao Inoguchi <yoshinao@inoguchi.com>

scripts.build: tsc && tsc --noEmit --composite false -p tsconfig.node.json && vite build
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit --composite false -p tsconfig.node.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && vitest run && cargo test --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml
